question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**classifies**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the function of BMI in categorizing different body weight statuses.
 
• The word should indicate the act of sorting or arranging bodies into categories.
 
• "**Classifies**" fits well as it means to categorize or arrange in groups, which aligns with the function of BMI.
 
• Other options ("**dissuades**", "**speculates**", "**meanders**") do not fit the context of what BMI does.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We’re a society fixated on numbers. So, it’s no (1).* *surprise__* *we use measurements and equations to score our weight. The most (2).* *__popular__* *is BMI, a measure of our body weight to height ratio. BMI (3).* *__classifies__* *bodies as underweight, normal or healthy weight, overweight or obese and can be a useful tool for weight and health (4).* **__________***. But it shouldn’t be used as the single (5).* **_________***of what it means to be a healthy weight when we set our weight loss goals.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Dissuades (रोकता है): "Dissuades" means to persuade someone not to take a particular course of action, which does not fit the context of BMI categorizing body weights.
 
• Speculates (अनुमान लगाता है): "Speculates" means to form a theory or conjecture about a subject without firm evidence, which does not align with the concept of BMI categorizing bodies.
 
• Meanders (घुमावदार रास्ता बनाता है): "Meanders" means to wander aimlessly, which does not fit the context of BMI categorizing body weights.
